abstract: A comparison of serum pregnancy specific beta 1 glycoprotein analysis by enzyme linked immunosorbent assay and radioimmunoassay has been made. Excellent correlation was obtained between the two methods but radioimmunoassay was found to be more precise and to have a lower detection limit than enzyme linked immunosorbent assay. Using the more sensitive radioimmunoassay system, 2 out of 10 control male sera were found to contain detectable levels of pregnancy specific beta 1 glycoprotein. Sequential results are presented on patients with diagnosed malignant teratoma of testis who were undergoing chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク(SP1)の血清分析について、酵素免疫測定法(ELISA)と放射免疫測定法(RIA)の比較を行った。両法の間には極めて良好な相関が得られたが、RIAはELISAより精度が高く、検出限界も低いことがわかった。より感度の高いRIA系を用いたところ、対照男性血清10例中2例に検出可能な濃度のSP1が認められた。精巣悪性奇形腫と診断され化学療法を受けている患者について、経時的な結果を示す。
